title: Policy-controller effects on unassisted mathematical transfer

population.consent: institutional ethics approval plus guardian and learner consent or assent as locally required

policy_arms.adaptive_controller: External state machine selects question-withhold after a productive attempt and explanation-reveal only after two failed attempts, an explicit stall, or a safety trigger.
policy_arms.static_question_withhold: Every eligible turn receives the frozen question-first and answer-withholding policy.
policy_arms.static_explain_reveal: Every eligible turn receives the frozen explanation-first and correct-answer-reveal policy.
policy_arms.model_default: The same grounded content and safety envelope is supplied without a question or answer policy clause.

randomization.allocation: equal across 4 policy arms and 3 hidden model routes

schedule.immediate_posttest: unassisted isomorphic and near-transfer items within 24 hours
schedule.delayed_posttest: unassisted isomorphic and far-transfer items seven days later

primary_estimand.outcome: delayed unassisted transfer score standardized to the pooled control distribution
primary_estimand.analysis: intention-to-treat ANCOVA with pretest, model route, classroom fixed effects, and classroom-clustered small-sample-corrected standard errors
primary_estimand.power_rule: two-independent-arm normal approximation with no credit for pretest adjustment or within-class blocking

measurement.scoring: exact numeric, symbolic-equivalence, or fixed-choice automatic scoring only

analysis_guards: The primary contrast and delayed outcome cannot be changed after enrollment begins.
All randomized learners remain in intention-to-treat analyses.
Report every policy arm and model-policy cell regardless of sign.
Use multiple imputation, inverse-probability weighting, and worst-case bounds as attrition sensitivity analyses.
Flag any arm difference above 5 percentage points in delayed-posttest completion.
Model-by-policy interactions are exploratory because three model routes do not define a model population.
No learning-effectiveness claim is eligible before ethics approval, registration, completed collection, and the frozen analysis.

safety.grounding: Every route receives curriculum content, worked solutions, and prohibited-answer timing rules.
safety.oversight: A teacher dashboard provides monitoring, escalation, and an immediate session kill switch.
safety.logging: Store randomized assignment, prompt version, model alias, timestamps, policy decisions, attempts, and errors; separate identifiers from research records.
safety.exclusions: No high-stakes grading, clinical advice, sensitive profiling, or unsupervised deployment to minors.
